# LiquidJava

LiquidJava extends Java with refinement types so developers can express stronger code restrictions and catch bugs before execution.

## Primary site

- Homepage: https://liquid-java.github.io/
- Documentation: https://liquid-java.github.io/liquidjava-docs/

## Related resources

- GitHub organization: https://github.com/liquid-java
- Verifier, API, and examples: https://github.com/liquid-java/liquidjava
- Documentation repository: https://github.com/liquid-java/liquidjava-docs
- Tutorial repository: https://github.com/liquid-java/liquidjava-tutorial
- VS Code extension repository: https://github.com/liquid-java/vscode-liquidjava
- VS Code Marketplace: https://marketplace.visualstudio.com/items?itemName=AlcidesFonseca.liquid-java
- Open VSX: https://open-vsx.org/extension/AlcidesFonseca/liquid-java
